releaseNotes:
WeChat 2.0 - Major Update

New Features:
- AI Smart Reply / Polish / Daily Digest
- Netease Cloud Music search & player
- GIF search & send
- Weather query / Zhihu Daily News
- GPS Map location sharing
- QR Code generator
- AI Image Recognition (GLM-4V)
- Group Events & Reminders
- Desktop Notifications

Improvements:
- Lucide linear icon system (1.2px stroke)
- Full mobile responsive layout
- Chat message delete (WeChat-style)
- Message limit 3000
- Chat privacy hardening
- Atomic file writes (crash-safe)
- Discover page scrollable
- Theme presets
